name: Robotis Bioloid
def: Robot kit for hobbyists and education from the South Korean company Robotis, using modular servo units that combine into wheeled, legged or humanoid machines.
facts: Built around daisy chained AX-12A Dynamixel servomotors
Programmed with the C based RoboPlus software
Often compared with Lego Mindstorms and VEX Robotics kits
